# Data attribution

`personas.json` and `profile_fields.json` are derived from the data package of the Tacto Negotiation
Arena, Tacto Technology GmbH, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
The supplier profiles in `personas.json` are summaries a language model wrote from that data; the
figures in them come from the package. `profile_fields.json` holds structured fields per supplier,
each with a verbatim quote from the package as evidence. Both were changed from the original by
summarising and extracting.
